default_model_handling: included everywhere; missing and null canonicalize to null; strings are trimmed; empty strings canonicalize to null
fallback_models_handling: included everywhere as an ordered array; missing/null canonicalizes to empty array; entries are string-normalized
hash_reproducibility: route_provider_fallback_sha256 = sha256(canonical JSON bytes of the canonical fingerprint object)

drift_comparison.shape_mismatch_classification: validator_shape_mismatch / FAIL_M3M_R2B_VALIDATION, not production route drift unless production config also changed
drift_comparison.route_provider_fallback_drift: shape parity true and route_provider_fallback_sha256 differs
drift_comparison.production_config_drift: production_config_sha256 differs; reported separately and still aborts

justification: default_model is production route authority for the owner/operator lane and was the missing field in the false R2 abort; including it everywhere preserves drift sensitivity without weakening gates. Fallbacks are included to detect fallback-chain drift. Full config hash is kept separate so unrelated config drift is visible without confusing route-fingerprint shape parity.
